descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: self-corrections and spelled-out names.

Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S14 Self-corrections and spelled-out names are kept as said

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Dictated numbers (doses, lab values, vital signs) are transcribed exactly: same value, nothing dropped, added or changed. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 3)
  • U2 Drug names are transcribed correctly or visibly flagged when uncertain. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 4)
  • T6 No dictated fact is silently dropped (Principle 2), including the last words before Stop and the words around an interruption or a recovery. (TFA-94229 R9) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Same setup as S01/S02

When Speak each sentence into the pre-round box

Then Both the first value and its correction stay in the transcript, in order; a spelled-out name comes out as the drug name

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): The transcript is the physician's words: a dropped correction or a dropped first value is a lost dictated fact (T6, U1); numbers exact and in order (S01 rule, both values of a correction included); deciding which value wins is the extractor's job downstream (TC-19, golden-set G47). Drug names per U2; …

Where it ran: local aicheck-dictation (dictation AI checks); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S14 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-23.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94229 in progress; TFA-94423 ready for qa

Evidence: allure-results/b2d7e54d…: same key precondition block. Self-test 2/2.
